title: Concept: Possible a Shopify Admin API access token in source
description: a Shopify Admin API access token values start with the fixed prefix shpat_ followed by a random body run. A committed value grants Admin API access to the store the app is installed on within its granted scopes, so exposure is high-impact even though the match alone cannot prove the token is active.
applicability: Any source, configuration, or CI file that embeds a Shopify custom-app or OAuth Admin API access token.
risk: A committed Admin API token exposes store data and write operations (orders, products, customers) within the app's granted scopes until it is revoked.
